question: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan was launched by whom in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan** was launched on **June 20, 2020**, by the **Prime Minister of India**, **Narendra Modi**. This initiative was aimed at providing immediate employment opportunities to migrant workers who had returned to their home states due to the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• The program was implemented in **116 districts** across six states: **Bihar**, **Uttar Pradesh**, **Madhya Pradesh**, **Rajasthan**, **Odisha**, and **Jharkhand**. These districts were selected based on the concentration of migrant workers.
 
• The initiative aimed to ensure the **economic empowerment** of migrant workers by providing them with **local employment opportunities** through various government schemes. *Hence, the correct answer is Prime Minister of India.*
 
• Under this program, **25 types of infrastructure projects** were undertaken, including **construction of roads**, **housing**, **plantation**, **water conservation**, and **community development**, among others. These projects were carried out under different **central and state government schemes**.
 
• An estimated **Rs. 50,000 crores** was allocated for the implementation of the scheme, ensuring both **employment generation** and the creation of durable infrastructure.
 
• The program also provided a platform for **skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workers** to find employment opportunities in their home states, thereby reducing their dependency on jobs in urban centers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objectives of Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan:**

 
 
• The primary objective of the program was to provide **immediate employment** to returning migrant workers affected by the **COVID-19 lockdown**.
 
• It aimed to create **durable assets** in rural areas, which would contribute to the long-term development and infrastructure improvement in these regions.
 
 
 
• **Implementation and Monitoring:**
 
 
• The initiative was coordinated by **12 ministries** of the central government, ensuring the convergence of various schemes.
 
• The program was monitored using **geo-tagging** and **mobile applications** to track the progress of projects and ensure accountability.
 
 
 
• **Key Features:**
 
 
• The initiative focused on promoting **self-reliance** by providing **skill development** opportunities to migrant workers.
 
• It also emphasized the importance of **local employment generation**, which reduced the need for migration to urban areas for work.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Abhiyan:**

 
 
• The scheme played a vital role in addressing the challenges posed by the **reverse migration** of workers during the pandemic.
 
• It contributed to improving **livelihood opportunities** in rural areas, thereby reducing economic distress among migrant workers.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• The program created **employment opportunities** for millions of workers and helped in the development of infrastructure in rural districts.
 
• It highlighted the importance of **converging government schemes** to achieve comprehensive development goals.
